name: @violice/preact-fluent-ui
description: Preact components and explicit Fluent-style CSS for desktop web applications

scripts.lint: oxlint src scripts tests/package-consumer examples/gallery vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts --max-warnings 0
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src scripts tests/package-consumer examples/gallery vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json package.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src scripts tests/package-consumer examples/gallery vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json package.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-css.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:release && npm run licenses:check
